required_inputs.title: Introduce Alya in a serene forest setting, establishing her character and peaceful demeanor
required_inputs.narrative_beat: In the ancient forest of Eldoria, where the trees whispered secrets to those who would listen, there lived a young woman named Alya. She was known throughout the realm for her gentle spirit and the way the creatures of the wild would gather around her as if drawn by some invisible thread of kindness.
